jobs_results.title: DESARROLLADOR FULLSTACK EN JAVA
jobs_results.company_name: ADELANTTA | Externalización Dpto. RRHH. Selección, Formación, Consultoría
jobs_results.description:
Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web escalables y de alto rendimiento, abarcando tanto el frontend como el backend, asegurando la integración efectiva de tecnologías y la entrega de soluciones innovadoras que cumplan con los objetivos del negocio.

Tareas
• Diseño, desarrollo, y mantenimiento de aplicaciones web FullStack utilizando
• Java, Spring Framework, y tecnologías relacionadas.
• Contribuir en todas las fases del ciclo de desarrollo de software, incluyendo
• requisitos, diseño, codificación, pruebas, y despliegue.
• Colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo y organizaciones implicadas para
• definir especificaciones de software y arquitecturas de referencia.
• Escritura de código limpio y eficiente, y realización de pruebas unitarias y de
• integración.
• Identificación y corrección de cuellos de botella y bugs, y mejora del rendimiento
• de las aplicaciones.
• Desarrollo de documentación técnica para referencia y reporte.

Requisitos

Formación básica mínima necesaria:
•... Grado en Ingeniería Técnica informática o Telecomunicaciones

Formación especializada necesaria:
• Certificaciones o cursos especializados en Java, Spring Framework y metodologías ágiles de desarrollo (SCRUM, Kanban).
• Nivel de idiomas:
• Inglés técnico avanzado (B2-C1), capaz de leer documentación y comunicarse
• eficazmente en un entorno de trabajo internacional.
• Herramientas de trabajo:
• Java 8, 17 y Spring 5, 6
• Entornos de desarrollo integrado (IDEs) como IntelliJ IDEA o Eclipse.
• Sistemas de control de versiones, preferentemente Git.
• Frameworks de desarrollo: Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate.
• Bases de datos: Oracle 12 o superior, MySQL.
• Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Ext JS, frameworks como Angular o React
• (deseable).

Experiencia mínima necesaria:
• Al menos 4-5 años de experiencia en desarrollo FullStack con Java.
• Detalles sobre experiencia específica que sean relevantes para el puesto:
• Experiencia demostrable en proyectos que hayan requerido trabajo con
• arquitecturas microservicios y desarrollo de API RESTful.
• Experiencia en la implementación de seguridad y autenticación en aplicaciones web.

Beneficios
• Salario bruto anual fijo y variable:
• Fijo: según experiencia y habilidades demostradas.
• Variable basado en el cumplimiento de objetivos y KPIs
• Horario de Lunes a Jueves de 8:30 – 18:00 y Viernes 8:00 a 15:00 h
• Verano jornada intensiva (1 Julio- 15 Sept) de 8:00 a 15:00 h
• Formación continua
• Lugar de trabajo: Madrid

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Java
jobs_results.description:
Yumatech is a technology company based in the Greater Barcelona Metropolitan Area with a mission to help companies transform and elevate their teams by providing access to the most talented professionals in the tech ecosystem. We empower our partners to fulfill their project requirements and grow at the speed they need, and we advise our talent on how to find their next challenging project, whether it's permanent or project-based. We fully adapt to your needs and goals as a professional

We are seeking a Back End Java developer with expertise in Java and Kubernetes/DevOps to join our team in Barcelona. In this role, you will be responsible for developing web applications on backend, collaborating closely with other team members to create innovative and high-quality solutions.

Qualifications
• Strong knowledge of Java, Azure Cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes and DevOps.
• Advanced level of English.
• Ability to work independently and in a team.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention... to detail.
• Strong work ethic and ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• Experience with agile software development methodologies is a plus.

The company offers...
• You will join a highly motivated team, where everyone is developing themselves to higher levels of professionality.
• Remote Working Model.
• Flexible working hours.

Do you want to know more about this position? You can contact me on LinkedIn or by e.mail: serena@yumatech.io

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer in SPAIN (remote / hybrid / office)
jobs_results.description:
Hey! ⚓

Get ready to set sails and navigate the rindus wave ⛵️

ABOUT US

We're rindus, a People company. We love IT professionals and our passion is to help and empower our crew to get the best out of themselves, unfold their full potential, and help them grow.

Because growth is in our mindset, we're doing it since 2017, closely with our German Partners, helping them shape their software development teams.

So far, we have 160+ crew members of 14 different nationalities sailing with us in the open seas. We ‘re expanding our team and looking for a new rinder to get on board. Are you the next to be reeled in? ⛴

ABOUT OUR PARTNER

On behalf of our partner LPS (Loyalty Partner Solutions), we are looking for the best talent to join rindus. LPS creates loyalty management software for companies as Lufthansa, Deutsche Bahn AG, PAYBACK and international air carriers such as China Southern Airlines and United Airlines. With the company headquarters in Munich (Germany), you will work in a... distributed team from our office in València (Spain).

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
• Together with your team you will develop JAVA-based software for our customers and bring it live
• Together with experienced colleagues from the team you will develop end2end solutions
• A high degree of automation is important to us, so you will also design and implement automated test cases
• You want to see your code in production as quickly as possible, which is why you will also take care of Continuous Delivery
• Communicate your solution ideas so that everyone can understand it
• Improve LMS platform by challenging the status quo and bring in your ideas
• Drive technology innovations to enable business innovations based on a platform
• Advice developers and juniors to grow with your experience by sharing your knowledge

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
• 7+ years of experience as Java Software Developer, including experience in complex software development environments
• You are eager to understand our customer domain to find the best solutions for our customer needs
• You love to actively drive topics, always having the goal in mind and accepting challenges
• You have a DevOps mindset (ship it as you would run it)
• You enjoy working in an international team
• You have an agile mindset and as part of a cross-functional team your open to support other disciplines if needed for the team success
• Excellent English is a prerequisite, German is a plus

TECHSTACK:

JAVA, JEE, Spring, SpringBoot, SOAP, REST, Hibernate, proficiency with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL), cloud-based systems (AWS or equivalent), Maven, Jenkins, Git, Mockito

WHAT WE OFFER

⛴ Being part of dynamic and highly motivated international multicultural team of skilled professionals.

☄️ Competitive compensation package.

⚖️ Flexible working model: You can choose the work model that fits your lifestyle (At office, hybrid or full remote)

⛱ 23 holiday days.

⏰ Flexible schedules with core working hours.

✔️ DKV private health insurance from day 1.

⛹ Gym Sponsorship.

✏️ English and German language classes.

✊ A young and ambitious team that knows when to work but also when to have fun (Pizza day, Summer event, Padel Tournaments, etc).

Navigate The rindus wave 🌊

jobs_results.title: Software Developer (TypeScript, Java)
jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos?
More than just IT

OSP (Otto Group Solution Provider) is an IT service provider for retail and logistics with headquarters in Dresden. We live our passion for IT in an appreciative, trusting work environment. What drives us is the idea of working together as a team to achieve great things for our customers.
We rely on the personal responsibility and willingness to learn of our employees, on modern technologies and high quality in software development. Agile working, transparent decisions, a lively feedback culture and collegial cooperation make us successful.

We are active for customers inside and outside the Otto Group. With over 450 employees at several German and international locations, we have been developing flexible software and BI solutions since 1991 and are thus shaping the shopping worlds of tomorrow. We are part of the Otto Group and share a value system that focuses on responsible and sustainable action.

What will you do?
• You will be responsible for... the product development, implementation and operation - you will elaborate all work content together with your colleagues, so we need you to be a proactive and creative person!
• You will work with cutting-edge technologies.
• You will be part of a cross-functional team together with our colleagues in Spain and Germany!

What’s your story?
• TypeScript experience.
• Experience in Java, ideally with Spring Boot.
• Knowledge of AWS or some other Cloud platform.
• Experience with IaC methodologies and tools (i.e. Terraform).
• Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).
• Good English skills, written and spoken.

Benefits
• Permanent contract
• Flexible working hours (you decide how to organize your day to day!)
• Hybrid work mode (work from home up to 80% of the time, having the rest to meet your colleagues at the office!)
• You will be part of a fast-growing company, being part of a great team
• Competitive salary
• Flexible retribution
• Medical insurance
• Agile working methods
• Training and Development: we have a clear focus on technical innovation, but we don’t forget the personal growth!

Contact
Mariel Mantecas
Otto Group Solution Provider Spain S.L.
Calle del Conde de Peñalver 38, 1º planta | 28006 Madrid
mariel.mantecas@ottogroup.com

jobs_results.title: BCNC Group: Senior Java Software Engineer (100% remoto)
jobs_results.description:
BCNC Group busca un/a Senior Java Software Engineer (100% remoto)

En BCNC GROUP buscamos incorporar Desarrolladores/as con al menos 4 años experiencia contrastada en programación Java, preferiblemente Java (8-11) para formar parte de nuestro equipo deslocalizado en una de las más importantes empresas españolas del sector Retail.

Tareas

Desarrolladores/as con al menos 4 años experiencia contrastada en programación Java, preferiblemente Java (8-11)

Requisitos

REQUISITOS:
• Experiencia comprobada en el desarrollo de aplicaciones Java y en el desarrollo de microservicios utilizando Spring Boot.
• Conocimientos avanzados de arquitectura hexagonal y los principios del Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
• Experiencia en el uso de bases de datos NoSQL, como MongoDB, Elasticsearch, principalmente. y Bases de Datos Relacionales.
• Experiencia en testing (Junit, Mockito, etc.)
• Experiencia en el diseño y desarrollo de APIs RESTful, con un enfoque de API First.
• Experiencia con RabbitMQ o algún... otro bróker de mensajería para la integración de sistemas y eventos.
• Principios SOLID y capacidad para aplicarlos en el desarrollo de software.
• Metodologías Agile: Scrum/Kanban
• Habilidades de resolución de problemas, trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva.
• Conocimientos o que haya trasteado con protobuf y gRPC.
• Sistemas de integración continua con verificación automática de código (Sonar, Lint, etc.), ejecución de tests, cobertura, etc.

Beneficios

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Contrato indefinido.
• Estabilidad laboral.
• Trabajar en importantes proyectos con las tecnologías más punteras.
• Posibilidad de realizar proyectos internacionales.
• Desarrollo de carrera real y formación.
• Retribución flexible (guardería, restaurante, seguro médico y transporte).
• Flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva viernes, julio y agosto

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Engineer (Java & Typescript)
jobs_results.description:
Overview

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of experience to join our innovative team.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of high-performance scalable applications, utilizing your expertise in Java, TypeScript, and related technologies. This position requires strong problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a commitment to

delivering quality software solutions while ensuring data accuracy.

Our company is at the forefront of the business software industry, managing large volumes of data for our customers daily.

Over two years ago, we established a new team in Barcelona to enhance our global development capabilities and enhance our product data analysis. This team is focused on building innovative

tools and resources to provide deeper insights into product usage and customer behavior.

What you will do

Your role will involve designing and creating internal tools used by NetSuite's... global development organization. These tools will include features for data collection, analysis, visualization, and more. To accomplish this, you'll need a deep understanding of NetSuite's cloud services and storage solutions. These tools will be essential for tracking usage metrics, KPIs, and performance data, especially considering that our cloud platform serves over 40,000 organizations worldwide. Are you ready for this challenge?

Additionally, you will collaborate closely with other development teams, departments, product management, user experience, and QA to define and implement these tools.

Your role will involve active participation in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to deployment and maintenance.

Furthermore, you will contribute to code reviews, offer constructive feedback to peers, uphold coding standards, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of projects.

We would love to collaborate with individuals who share these values
• Open-mindedness, honesty, and transparency, fostering discussions and team collaboration.
• You take pride in your work and are driven by a desire to delight the customer; this motivates you to take responsibility and ownership of your projects.
• A strong commitment to excellence and adherence to clean code principles in software design.

Qualifications/Skills
• Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) or relevant experience
• Minimum of 3 years of software development experience
• Strong proficiency in Java and/or C#, Kotlin, or similar languages
• Proficiency in TypeScript
• Commitment to ensuring data integrity in software solutions
• Experience in designing, architecting and implementing high-performance scalable applications
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

Nice to have
• Experience with React
• Experience with Test Driven Development (TDD)
• Familiarity with SQL and Elastic
• Exposure to Data Analytics and Performance Monitoring
• Understanding of cloud-based distributed software applications
• Experience with Agile/SCRUM development methodologies

Our Stack and Tools
• Java, Kotlin
• JavaScript, TypeScript
• SQL (Oracle databases)
• Elastic, Open search & Kibana
• IntelliJ IDEA, Teamcity
• Jira, Confluence
• GitLab

What we offer
• Agile environment – Start-up culture backed by a strong enterprise
• English-speaking environment and international team
• Free Spanish classes
• Strong professionals around you that will help to accelerate your growth
• High-impact learning culture: free access to online learning platforms and regular in-house training sessions
• 25 days of paid vacation
• Flexible working hours
• Private medical insurance and life insurance
• Ticket restaurant card
• Oracle NetSuite is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits of employment
